query: Who won the most recent FIFA World Cup?
answer: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, the latest edition. They beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time in the final on July 19, 2026, at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. FIFA called the venue "New York New Jersey Stadium" for the tournament [1][2]. Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute [1][2]. This is Spain's second men's World Cup title, after 2010 [1].

sources.title: Spain is the 2026 World Cup champion, defeating Argentina for its 2nd title
